description: Injected CANCELLATION mid-flight: a memory selection is held and a workflow delegation decision is live when a session is cancelled (releaseTask) and then disposed (pinned session/disposed emit, then a REAL fiber dispose). Selection state must be released exactly, the surviving session must be untouched by the cancelled session's cleanup, lookups must stay empty afterwards (no resurrection, no cross-session contamination), and the fiber dispose must complete within the ceiling with no dangling state.
